subject: Harry Kane
title: Kane: three lost finals and a knighthood

lines.vo: Three lost finals, one Ballon d'Or, and a knighthood question?
lines.footage: Kane close-up after a lost final, England or Tottenham era, clean feed

lines.vo: Kane still wants a big trophy, and the Champions League is the big goal.
lines.footage: Kane training at Bayern, focused expression, clean club footage

lines.vo: Lost the 2019 Champions League final to Liverpool, two-nil. Then Euro 2020. Then Euro 2024. A very shiny silver collection.
lines.footage: 2019 Champions League final highlights, Tottenham, then England Euro 2020 and Euro 2024 final defeat shots, clean broadcast feeds

lines.vo: Bayern paid a reported one hundred and twenty million euros. Uli Hoeness called it crazy. Later he said he would have paid one hundred and fifty. Crazy became cheap.
lines.footage: Kane Bayern unveiling 2023, press conference, clean club feed

lines.vo: Asked about a knighthood, Kane would not turn one down, but 'Sir' would feel odd. Sir Harry: sounds like a butler, plays like a striker.
lines.footage: Kane answering reporters in Munich, neutral press shot

lines.vo: A Patriots quarterback says Kane could be an NFL kicker. Kane says Bayern come first. The NFL can join the queue.
lines.footage: Kane striking a dead-ball kick in training, clean club footage

lines.vo: ESPN's November top ten has him fifth, behind Yamal, Bellingham, Olise and Raphinha. Fifth, and still the Ballon d'Or winner. Awkward.
